question: Which of the following tribal dances is performed in Tripura by the Mog community?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangrai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Sangrai dance is performed by the Mog community in Tripura.
 
• This dance is a significant cultural expression of the Mog tribe.
 
• It is usually performed during the Sangrai festival, which marks the traditional New Year of the Mog community.
